text:
World in a kiss

The musician with hazel drumsticks sewn into his sleeves

Calms a swarm of young monkey-lions

that came down with great clamor from the cornice

Everything grows opaque; I see the carriage of night pass

Dragged by axolotls in blue shoes

that enters, radiant, through the violence leading to the tomb

paved with eyelids and their eyelashes

The law of retaliation employs a people of stars

And you take on for me the hues of a black dew

While the horrible mental terminals

split open along their length

making way for plumes

that gaze at the nearby lake

The bars of the spectacle are marvelously twisted

A long spindle of air bears witness only to man's flight

At daybreak among the illustrious alfalfa

The hour

is only what the gold pieces of Bohemia make ring

on the blades of coriaria

An amazon standing on a tawny-gray horse at a gallop

From far away the arms are always in lateral extension

The dusty diamond of the lining reminds me

of the shop decorated with blue bison

by the Indians of the pillow

Outside, the air tries on mistletoe gloves

on a counter of pure water

World in a clean kiss

For me, the scales

The scales of the great celestial tortoise with a hydrofilic belly

that struggles each night in love

with the great black tortoise, the gigantic scolopendra of roots

translation.title: World in a Kiss
translation.editorial_note: The translation retains the deliberately impossible animals, objects, and celestial tortoise imagery without explaining the surreal transitions.
